description: Synthesizes the potentially chaotic CHIRIKOV STANDARD MAP as audio - a pure generator with NO audio input (input_arity 0). Mode 1 iterates the standard map driven at frq with nonlinearity 'damping'; DAMPING'S ENFORCED RANGE IS 0 to 12.566371 = EXACTLY 4*PI ('Parameter[3] Value (100.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 12.566371)') - it is the map's K stochasticity parameter: below ~1 the output is a quiet quasi-periodic hum, rising K drives period-doubling and chaos (level also rises: damping 0.1 peaks 0.56, damping 3 peaks 0.90). Both frq (0.001-10000) and damping are BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (each verified to differ from both scalar-endpoint renders). Output duration is set sample-exactly by dur (2.0 -> 88200); the floor is the dovetail splice ('Duration too short for dovetailing splices.' at 0.01 s) and NO ceiling is enforced (7201 s accepted - the engine's duration cap is the real guard; curated max 7200). srate range gate 16000-96000; dovesplice 1-50 ms. Deterministic (runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical). Mode 2 (circle map) shares the exact argv shape and is deterministic with a distinct render - uncurated sibling; modes 3-4 (breakpoint-data outputs) are DROPPED: they strip the output extension (write 'X' when told 'X.txt'), breaking the engine's output contract.
musical_use: Chaos as a playable oscillator: sweep damping (the K parameter) with a breakpoint file and one render walks from near-sine hum through period-doubled growl into broadband chaos - the classic route-to-chaos as a gesture (verified live: a 0.1->3 damping ramp differs from both fixed-K renders). Keep damping under ~1 for stable quasi-periodic drones with odd sidebands; ride 1-4 for gritty unstable tones; above 6 it is coloured noise. frq scales the iteration rate - sub-100 Hz values give rumbling textures, kHz values glassy noise. Layer mode-1 renders at slightly different damping for thick detuned chaos beds, or feed the output to filter bank to pick resonances out of the mess. Deterministic: every point on the chaos map is re-renderable exactly.

dur.description: Output duration in seconds - sample-exact (2.0 -> 88200 frames). Floor = dovetail splices ('Duration too short for dovetailing splices.' at 0.01 with 15 ms splices); NO CDP ceiling (7201 accepted) - curated max 7200, the engine duration cap is the guard. Required.

frq.description: Driving frequency of the map iteration, CDP-enforced 0.001 to 10000 ('Parameter[2] Value (23000.000000) out of range (0.001000 to 10000.000000)'). BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 220->880 differs from both endpoint renders). Output level varies with frq (higher drive = louder on this map).

damping.description: The map's stochasticity parameter K, CDP-enforced 0 to 12.566371 = 4*pi ('Parameter[3] Value (100.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 12.566371)'; -1 refused). Low = quasi-periodic hum, ~1-4 = period-doubling grit, high = chaos (and higher level: peak 0.56 at 0.1, 0.90 at 3). BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 0.1->3 differs from both endpoints) - the route-to-chaos slider.

srate.description: Output sample rate, range gate 16000 to 96000 ('Parameter[4] Value (11025.000000) out of range (16000.000000 to 96000.000000)'). Positional - always emitted (default 44100).

dovesplice.description: Dovetail splice at start and end, CDP-enforced 1 to 50 ms ('Parameter[5] Value (0.500000) out of range (1.000000 to 50.000000)'; 60 refused). Also floors the usable dur. Positional - always emitted (default 15).

examples.description: Quasi-periodic hum on the edge of instability.
examples.expected_use: No input argument. Quiet (peak ~0.11) unstable hum; deterministic - same render every time.

examples.description: The route to chaos as one gesture.
examples.expected_use: K climbs from hum through period-doubling into broadband chaos; level rises with K - leave headroom.

known_issues: damping's range is exactly 4*pi (12.566371) - it is the Chirikov map's K parameter, not an amplitude damping; output LEVEL rises with it (0.56 -> 0.90 peak observed).
dur has NO CDP ceiling (7201 s accepted) - the engine's duration cap/watchdog is the guard; the floor is the dovetail splice refusal (verbatim).
Output level varies strongly with frq and damping (peak 0.06-0.90 observed) - normalize downstream when layering.
Deterministic: no seed, no clock dependence (runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical).

Mode 2 (circle map) shares the argv shape, renders distinctly, equally deterministic - uncurated sibling. Modes 3-4 (time/MIDI breakpoint-file outputs) are DROPPED: the binary STRIPS the output extension (writes 'X' when the argv says 'X.txt'), so the engine's expected output file never exists.
Generator entry: process() takes no input argument; graph()/batch()/sweep() refuse arity-0 entries (arity_zero_unsupported).
